title: 808. Chalkboard XOR Game

examples.explanation: The xor of all numbers is 2 (nonzero) and the count is odd, so the first player cannot force erasing everything.
With an even count the first player has a mirroring strategy even though the xor is nonzero.
The xor of the whole board is already 0, so the first player wins immediately.

hints: XOR every entry once: a zero total means the board is already balanced.
When the total is nonzero, the parity of the length decides the winner: even favors the first player, odd favors the second.
